verdict.rationale: Greptile lets customers control where data lives only by self-hosting. Its docs describe deployment in your own infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure, air-gapped, VPC) with logs stored on customer servers only. There is no evidence of choosing a storage region or residency option for the hosted SaaS, so residency control means running and operating the stack yourself. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for hosted SaaS, documented data-residency regions or commitments, independent corroboration.
